{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for rows with commas in revenue
commas_in_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Display the rows with commas
print('Rows with commas in revenue:')
print(completed_orders[commas_in_revenue]['revenue'])

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_clean = completed_orders.copy()
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if any revenue values are suspiciously high
print('\nTop 5 highest revenue values:')
print(df_clean['revenue'].sort_values(ascending=False).head())

# Aggregate total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

# Identify the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.index[0]
best_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]

print(f'\nTotal revenue by channel:\n{total_revenue_by_channel}')
print(f'\nChannel with highest total revenue: {best_channel} (${best_revenue:,.2f})')"}
